title: Use Cotangent Definition
text: Cotangent is the reciprocal of tangent: cot(A) $$=$$ $$\frac{1}tan^$\left(A\righ$$ $$=$$ $$\frac{adjacent}{opposite}$$.

title: Identify the Sides
text: The side adjacent to angle A is $$8$$ and the opposite side is $$10$$, so cot(A) $$=$$ $$\frac{8}{10}$$ $$=$$ $$0.8$$.
